title: Safety Connect Trial Expired
location: At home, worried about tonight's highway trip
coverage: Safety Connect trial expired; roadside 1-800-444-4195 still available

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: My SOS button does not work. Both lights are off. I thought Safety Connect was included with the car.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Both lights off usually means the trial or subscription is inactive. Green is active. I can help you re-enroll in the Toyota app.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: What if I need help on the highway tonight?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You can still use roadside at 1-800-444-4195 or the Toyota app 24/7 button. SOS with GPS dispatch needs an active Safety Connect trial or paid subscription.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Please restore Safety Connect. I do not want to be without SOS.
